headline: Result Update

highlights: Positives: • Healthy store expansion continues. • Strong growth driven primarily by higher volumes in both India and international segments. • Lenskart has added 143 stores in India in Q2FY27. • Lenskart reported SSSG of 21% in Q2FY27. • We model a revenue CAGR of 26% and a PAT CAGR of 53% over FY26-29.
